Hey guys,
May I present my second map, Illuminate! (Name credit goes to TheRomanTrident)

Things added / changed / improved In V1:
-Added more paths
-Added more islands
-Improved aesthetics
-Added diamond ore near spawn on new islands

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
I am deeply sorry that no comment has been left by a Map Developer on this thread regarding acceptance or denial.

I think that this map has a really neat shape to it. I love what you did with the iron pile, rather than having a plain mound of iron, you made a cool little structure to go along with it. Perhaps there is a bit too much void space and a couple of the islands are just a little bit blocky.

Some of the floor patterns could be revised, as they are blank or too plain. May I also point out that there are a couple unneeded signs and chests that contain nothing. In conclusion, I think this is an overall good map and will accept it. Congratulations!
